snippet.title: [Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Rondo of War] New trailer to commemorate the release of the game!
snippet.description:
Legend of the Galactic Heroes game will be released today!

■ Game Introduction
Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Rondo of War is a game adapted from the series Legend of the Galactic Heroes. Develop production facilities, strengthen your forces, participate in space battles, and strive for greatness as a military officer.

■ Play now
https://s.g123.jp/3psddt1x

■ Various campaigns to acquire allies in-game!
Players can choose either the 'Galactic Empire' or the 'Free Planets Alliance' at the start of the game. Regardless of faction, you can have characters from both factions as allies, but the characters that can be acquired may change depending on in-game events and campaigns. Choose your favorite faction and play the game.

■ Game Information
Game Title: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Rondo of War
Genre: Simulation Game
Price: Free-to-play (in-game item purchases available)

■ Click here for the latest information
https://g123.jp/game/57?lang=en

■ Click here for G123
https://g123.jp/?lang=en
